'''2011 Bespin Regionals Josiah Benedict LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josiah Benedict]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing|V16-L-communing.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Peterbuilt
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
